key_entities: degradation-path tests run with NO agents extra
propositions: The degradation-path test step in _optionality.yml's clean-core-wheel job runs two test files without independent predates-gate guards, causing pytest to collect nothing and exit 4 when the patchset base predates either file, resulting in undeserved Verified -1.

A sibling step in the same workflow already guards a different test file correctly using the two-generator per-file pattern, demonstrating the fix exists but was not applied to the degradation-path step.
Each test file must be guarded independently so that a tree containing one file but not the other still executes the present test file.
The workflow step must carry -f guards naming each test file and exit 0 with the canonical skip message when both test files are absent.
